summary: Dispatches formatting of a vehicle setup value by value type a3 (0=angle in degrees, 1=pressure with unit system branch on this+4, 2/3/9=length with optional wheel-type offset, 4=DS, 5-8=1fS, 10=integer count). Indexes into a 64-byte-strided per-value row: result = ((a3 + 11*a2) << 6) + this + 176. Formats through StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck or the SetupValueFormat* helpers; default returns the row pointer unformatted.

case 1 (pressure): branch on the unit-system flag at this+4; non-zero selects imperial formatting, zero selects metric.
case 1 imperial: compute v5 = (int row+20) * (double row+8) + *row, scale by dbl_59EA28 (0.1450377377387031 PSI conversion), format '%.1f %s' with unit at this+8 into row+206.
case 1 metric: format the truncated integer v5 with '%d %s' and unit at this+8 into row+206.
case 2 (length): select a wheel-type-dependent double offset from the dbl_59EA30 constants based on a2 (1 or 2); any other a2 passes offset 0.0.
cases 2, 3, 9: SetupValueFormatWithOffset(this, row, offset) formats the length with the optional offset term.
case 4: SetupValueFormatDS(this, row) formats the degrees/seconds setup value (aDS string constant).
cases 5-8: SetupValueFormat1fS(this, row) formats a single float with unit (a1fS string constant).
case 10 (integer count): format *row+20 + 1 as '%d' into row+30 via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck.
default: return the row pointer without formatting.
